item.title: Kevin Feige Says 'Avengers: Secret Wars' "Is A Whole Other Genre Of Story" Compared To 'Doomsday,' With Joe Russo Teasing "A Really Unique World"
item.description: How different can " Avengers: Secret Wars " be from next month's " Avengers: Doomsday "? Well, both Marvel Studios ' Kevin Feige and co-director Joe Russo are giving us some minor hints about where the sixth "Avengers" installment could be going and are promising that it won't be a run-of-the-mill follow-up. The folks over at Empire Magazine spoke with the two as they mused cryptically about their next massive event film, "Secret Wars," and Russo possibly telegraphing Battleworld (where heroes and villains from the comics are brought to battle each other for amusement) could be in the cards, something long suspected by fans of the comic book source material. Continue reading Kevin Feige Says 'Avengers: Secret Wars' "Is A Whole Other Genre Of Story" Compared To 'Doomsday,' With Joe Russo Teasing "A Really Unique World" at The Playlist.
